name: filter-bar-managed
title: Filter Builder
description: The stateful nested and/or filter builder — host-injected field grammar (vocabulary + per-type value editors), depth and condition caps, focus-managed removal, and a removable FilterChip summary.

meta.whenToUse: Structured, saveable filters with nesting — build an and/or tree over a host-supplied field grammar with per-type value editors and caps.
meta.whenNotToUse: A presentational chip row over host-owned filter state (filter-bar), or free-text search (Input in a toolbar).
